description: Exposed by fz-k22.7 Layer C. ir_interp/backend.rs resolve_backend_callable_executable errors ambiguous when >=2 candidate entries share (fn_id, capture_count, arg_count) and neither dominates. Root: by dispatch time the callee has collapsed from a transport-shaped value (carries CallableId) to a raw runtime closure/FnRef via ProgramStep::Lambda -> make_closure, which stores only function.as_u32() -- the same ambiguous structural key, no resolved-target field. Recovering identity from the call sites TransportPosition::Value shape is UNSOUND (that shape is the erased/generic/pooling callable type, matched 20-43 unrelated boundaries -> risks miscompile). Native codegen avoids this because callable_value_boundaries is populated per-Var at each MakeClosure CONSTRUCTION site. CORRECT FIX: embed resolved-target identity into the interpreters heap closure representation (mirror native body_addr embedded in the closure header alongside structural fid) -- a fz_runtime::heap closure-layout change touching interp + native construction sites + GC. Materially bigger than a dispatch-site plumbing fix. Blocks enum_predicate_search::interp + enum_take_drop_split::interp.
title: fz-k22: interpreter runtime closure repr loses resolved-target identity -- ambiguous dispatch when structurally-equal callables pool (needs identity in the heap closure header like native body_addr)
